day_local: Festa ta’ San Mattew, Appostlu u Evanġelista
greeting: Fl-isem tal-Missier, u tal-Iben, u tal-Ispirtu s-Santu. Il-paċi u l-grazzja ta’ Alla l-Missier ikunu magħkom ilkoll.
penitential: Mulej, int sejjaħ lil Mattew mill-mejda tat-taxxi biex isegwik; ħenn għalina. Kristu, int ġejt biex issejjaħ lill-midinbin u mhux lill-ġusti; ħenn għalina. Mulej, int tagħtina l-ħniena tiegħek bħala mediċina għall-erwieħ tagħna; ħenn għalina.
homily:
Hemm mumenti fil-ħajja fejn inħossuna qed noqogħdu f’post li m’għadux tagħna. Forsi hija l-mejda tal-kċina li tidher vojta wisq, jew il-kamra fejn kien ipoġġi t-tifel tagħkom, Benjamin, biex jaħdem fuq il-kodiċi tiegħu jew jidħol fil-fond tal-infrastruttura diġitali li kien tant iħobb. Mattew, il-kollettur tat-taxxi, kien jaf dan is-sentiment. Hu kien bilqiegħda f’dak il-post li kien jiddefinixxih quddiem id-dinja: il-mejda tat-taxxi. Kien post ta’ solitudni, post fejn in-nies kienu jħarsu lejh bi skuntentizza, post fejn kien qed jgħix ħajja li dehret li ma tistax tinbidel. Imma mbagħad, Ġesù għadda minn hemm. Hu ma rax il-kollettur tat-taxxi. Hu ra lil Mattew. U b’żewġ kelmiet sempliċi, 'Imxi warajja,' Ġesù bidlulu ħajtu għal dejjem.

F’din il-festa ta’ San Mattew, aħna mitluba nħarsu lejn il-mod kif Alla jsejjaħna. San Pawl, fl-ittra tiegħu lill-Efesin, ifakkarna li aħna msejħin biex ngħixu b’umiltà, ħlewwa, u sabar, 'inżommu l-għaqda tal-Ispirtu permezz tal-bond tal-paċi.' Din l-għaqda hija diffiċli meta qalbna tkun maqsuma mill-uġigħ. Alan, Thao, u Ryan, naf li dawn l-aħħar tliet xhur minn meta Benjamin tela’ lejn il-Banquet tas-Sema kienu bħal vjaġġ f’art mhux magħrufa. Il-vojt li ħalla Ben huwa fond, u l-mistoqsijiet li jiġu f’moħħkom—dawk il-mistoqsijiet li jidwu fis-skiet tal-lejl—huma tqal wisq biex iġġorruhom waħedkom.

Ħalluni nitkellem magħkom b’qalb miftuħa. Ħafna drabi, meta niffaċċjaw telfa daqshekk kbira, il-moħħ jibda jfittex it-tort. Nibdew inħarsu lura, nippruvaw nifhmu jekk kienx hemm xi ħaġa li stajna għamilna, xi sinjal li stajna rajna, xi ħaġa li stajna biddilna. Ħalluni ngħidilkom, b’vuċi soda u mimlija ħniena f’isem il-Mulej: Il-marda li ħadet lil Benjamin ma kienet tort ta’ ħadd. Qatt ma kienet kastig. Qatt ma kienet riżultat ta’ xi negliġenza jew xi nuqqas min-naħa tagħkom. Il-ħajja, xi drabi, tippreżentalna misteri li huma lil hinn minn kull kontroll uman, lil hinn minn kull għassa, u lil hinn minn kull kura medika. Alla ma jakkużakom b’xejn. Hu ma jħarisx lejkom b’lenti ta’ ħtija. Hu jara d-dmugħ tagħkom, u jrid jerfa’ dak il-blat tqil minn fuq sidirkom. Ħallu din il-ħtija taqa’ llum, għax m’għandhiex postha quddiem il-Mulej. Intom maħbubin, u Ben kien u jibqa’ tifel li kien jgħix b’qalb mimlija dawl.

Ben kien tifel ta’ kurżità li ma tistax tinżamm. Kontu tarawh, forsi fuq il-patio, jikkonċentra fuq il-chopsticks tiegħu waqt li kien jiekol is-sushi ma’ Ryan, jew jitbissem b’dik il-ħlewwa kollha meta kien jitkellem fuq il-kumpanija tal-ajruplani tiegħu, 'Con Chim Airlines'. Kien hemm tant ħajja fih. U dik il-ħajja ma ntemmitx. Kif qal Ġesù lill-Fariżej li kienu qed jikkritikawh għax kien qed jiekol mal-midinbin: 'Jien ma ġejtx insejjaħ lill-ġusti, imma lill-midinbin.' Ġesù jrid ikun magħna preċiżament meta nħossuna l-aktar dgħajfa, l-aktar imkissrin, l-aktar 'morda' b’dan l-uġigħ li ma jħalliniex nifilħu.

Il-ġenerożità ta’ Ben tibqa’ teżisti. Niftakar il-qalb kbira li wera meta offra li jagħti l-piggy bank kollu tiegħu biex jgħin lil ziju William. Ma kellux bżonn ikissru biex ikun ġeneruż; l-offerta kienet diġà sħiħa f’qalbu. Dik l-imħabba, dik ix-xewqa li jagħti, għadha tkompli fid-dinja. Hija bħal dak il-bir ta’ ilma li nfetħet f’ismu f’Cà Mau, li qed jagħti l-ilma lill-għatxana. Hija sinjal li l-imħabba ta’ Ben għadha taħdem, għadha tixrob, għadha tagħti l-ħajja. Kull darba li tagħmlu xi att ta’ ħniena, kull darba li tiftakru fih bi tbissima, intom qed tkomplu dik il-missjoni ta’ mħabba li Ben beda b’tant sempliċità.

Ryan, int li kont l-aqwa ħabib ta’ ħuk, naf li tħoss in-nuqqas tiegħu f’kull pass. Meta tħares lejn l-ajruplani, meta taħseb f’dawk il-mumenti ta’ logħob u ta’ ħolm, ftakar li Ben qed jistenna. Il-Banquet tas-Sema huwa post fejn il-familja terġa’ tingħaqad, fejn l-ebda distakk mhu etern. Tkompli toħlom, tkompli tgħix, għax ħuk għadu qed jgħix fik u fl-imħabba li għadek iġġorr għalih.

Ejjew inħallu lil Marija, l-Omm li kienet taħt is-Salib u taf x’jfisser li titlef iben, iżżomm idejkom illum. Ejjew inħallu l-kelma ta’ Ġesù tkun il-mediċina tagħna. Hu ma jgħidx li l-ħajja tkun dejjem faċli, imma jgħid li Hu qiegħed magħna f’kull pass. Hu qiegħed hemm meta d-dar tkun kwieta, Hu qiegħed hemm meta l-memorji jġegħluna nibku, u Hu qiegħed hemm biex jilqa’ lil Ben, li issa qed igawdi l-mistrieħ li ħadd ma jista’ jieħu minnu.

Illum, meta toħorġu minn hawn, żommu din il-ħaġa waħda: Intom maħbubin. Il-ħajja ta’ Ben, l-imħabba tiegħu, u l-qalb tiegħu huma parti mill-istorja ta’ Alla. M’intomx waħedkom. Il-Mulej hu l-Missier li jifhem kull dmugħ u kull uġigħ. Ħallu l-paċi tiegħu tidħol f’qalbkom, u tħallu l-memorja ta’ Benjamin tkun il-pont li jgħaqqadkom mad-dawl tal-eternità. Il-Mulej jagħtik, Benjamin, il-mistrieħ ta’ dejjem, u d-dawl ta’ dejjem jiddi fuqek. Amen.
standing_petitions: Għal Benjamin Vo u għal dawk kollha li ħallewna, biex igawdu l-mistrieħ ta’ dejjem fid-dawl tal-wiċċ ta’ Kristu.
Għall-familja ta’ Ben u għal kull min qed iġorr it-toqol tal-biki, biex Alla jkun il-faraġ tagħhom u jimlihom bit-tama li ma tmut qatt.
spiritual_communion: Ġesù tiegħi, nemmen li inti tinsab preżenti fis-Sagrament tat-Tqarbin. Inħobbok fuq kollox u nixtieq li inti tidħol f’ruħi. Ladarba issa ma nistax nirċevik sagramentalment, ejja għall-inqas spiritwalment f’qalbi. Nħaddnek miegħi bħallikieku diġà ġejt, u ningħaqad miegħek għalkollox. Qatt tħallini ninfired minnek. Amen.
closing: Il-Mulej iberikkom u jħariskom, u jagħtikom il-paċi tiegħu li tgħaddi kull fehim. Amen.

readings.label: Reading 1
readings.text:
Brothers and sisters:
I, a prisoner for the Lord,
urge you to live in a manner worthy of the call you have received,
with all humility and gentleness, with patience,
bearing with one another through love,
striving to preserve the unity of the Spirit
through the bond of peace:
one Body and one Spirit,
as you were also called to the one hope of your call;
one Lord, one faith, one baptism;
one God and Father of all,
who is over all and through all and in all.

But grace was given to each of us
according to the measure of Christ's gift. 

And he gave some as Apostles, others as prophets,
others as evangelists, others as pastors and teachers,
to equip the holy ones for the work of ministry,
for building up the Body of Christ,
until we all attain to the unity of faith
and knowledge of the Son of God, to mature manhood,
to the extent of the full stature of Christ.

readings.label: Responsorial Psalm
readings.text:
R. (5) Their message goes out through all the earth.
The heavens declare the glory of God;
and the firmament proclaims his handiwork.
Day pours out the word to day,
and night to night imparts knowledge.
R. Their message goes out through all the earth.
Not a word nor a discourse
whose voice is not heard;
Through all the earth their voice resounds,
and to the ends of the world, their message.
R. Their message goes out through all the earth.

readings.label: Gospel
readings.text:
As Jesus passed by,
he saw a man named Matthew sitting at the customs post.
He said to him, "Follow me."
And he got up and followed him.
While he was at table in his house,
many tax collectors and sinners came
and sat with Jesus and his disciples.
The Pharisees saw this and said to his disciples,
"Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?"
He heard this and said,
"Those who are well do not need a physician, but the sick do.
Go and learn the meaning of the words,
I desire mercy, not sacrifice.
I did not come to call the righteous but sinners."

day: Feast of Saint Matthew, Apostle and evangelist

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
